entry.title: ZoneMinder up to 1.37.63 web/ajax/event.php sql injection
entry.summary: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, has been found in ZoneMinder up to 1.37.63 (Video Surveillance Software). Affected by this issue is some unknown processing of the file web/ajax/event.php. Upgrading to version 1.37.64 eliminates this vulnerability. Applying the patch 9e7d31841ed9678a7dd06869037686fc9925e59f is able to eliminate this problem. The bugfix is ready for download at github.com. The best possible mitigation is suggested to be upgrading to the latest version.

details.affected: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, has been found in ZoneMinder up to 1.37.63 (Video Surveillance Software).
details.vulnerability: Using CWE to declare the problem leads to CWE-89. The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended SQL command when it is sent to a downstream component.
details.impact: Impacted is confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
details.exploit: By approaching the search of inurl:web/ajax/event.php it is possible to find vulnerable targets with Google Hacking.
details.countermeasure: Upgrading to version 1.37.64 eliminates this vulnerability. Applying the patch 9e7d31841ed9678a7dd06869037686fc9925e59f is able to eliminate this problem. The bugfix is ready for download at github.com. The best possible mitigation is suggested to be upgrading to the latest version.

cve.summary: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. ZoneMinder v1.37.* <= 1.37.64 is vulnerable to boolean-based SQL Injection in function of web/ajax/event.php. This is fixed in 1.37.64.
